title: ooRexx Memory Fabric
purpose: Preserve memory-block identity, owner-epoch fencing, provider residency, locality and transport-neutral execution placement, with qualified XTP service/multicast/capacity integration boundaries and continuation evidence. Read-side ingress validates authenticated identity/ACL and each page against authoritative provider incarnation. XTP dev34 encrypted service-key provenance and live key revocation are bound at source-side read admission; remote page delivery is still unqualified.
